contentHtml:
The partnership brings together the clinical expertise and professional network of INS with Polymed’s commitment to clinical education and capability development through PACE

The Infusion Nursing Society (INS) and Poly Medicure Ltd. (Polymed) have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to strengthen clinical knowledge and capability building among healthcare professionals through the Polymed Academy of Clinical Excellence (PACE).

As part of the collaboration, Poly Medicure will serve as the Knowledge Partner for INS through PACE, supporting access to clinical education, training and knowledge-sharing initiatives for INS members.

The partnership brings together the clinical expertise and professional network of INS with Polymed’s commitment to clinical education and capability development through PACE. The collaboration aims to foster continuous learning, promote knowledge exchange and contribute to advancing standards of infusion nursing and patient care.

Commenting on the partnership, Col Binu Sharma, CEO, Infusion Nursing Society, said, “We are delighted to partner with Poly Medicure and PACE in our shared commitment towards strengthening clinical knowledge and advancing infusion nursing practice. This collaboration will provide a valuable platform for learning, knowledge exchange and professional development for our members.

Indranil Mukherjee, CEO – India & APAC, Poly Medicure, said, “We are pleased to collaborate with the Infusion Nursing Society as its Knowledge Partner through PACE. At Polymed, we believe that advancing healthcare is not only about innovation in products and technology, but also about building clinical knowledge, skills and confidence among healthcare professionals. This partnership is an important step in our journey to create meaningful platforms for continuous learning and knowledge exchange, and to contribute to the advancement of infusion care and, ultimately, better patient outcomes.”

The MoU will reinforce the shared commitment of both organisations to clinical excellence, continuous learning and better healthcare outcomes.
